context: Four candidates: (1) a slot for an outside reason, such as the Riftbound meta, (2) net after fees, (3) select many rows and apply one change, (4) a watch list with a price alert. Pick a set below, or name your own mix in the note.

options.gain: Room for the Riftbound work later, at no cost now.
options.how: Rows get room for a reason such as 'meta-dependent'.
options.label: Outside-reason slot only

options.how: Each row also shows what you keep after TCGplayer fees.
options.label: Reason slot plus net after fees

options.how: Also bulk edit and a watch list.
options.label: All four
options.lose: A second way to set prices, and the watch list overlaps today's hold watch.

title: Which extra pricing tools should be built?
why: The rest add surface with no measured need.
